adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the backfill inserts host strings via raw SQL (`execute "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`), which bypasses `EmbeddableHost`’s `before_validation` normalization (stripping scheme/path) in app/models/embeddable_host.rb. If the old `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` contained entries like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (as shown in updated specs), those values would be stored verbatim in the table. Later, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` parses a URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, which won’t match stored values that still include scheme/path, breaking host_allow checks after migration. The SQL interpolation is also unescaped, so quotes in `h` could break the migration or worse, and none of this migration behavior is tested in the diff.
